INFO.NAME: PresenceSimulation
INFO.AUTHOR: JVP
INFO.DESCRIPTION: Recording and time-accurate playback of KNX/EIB telegrams (DPT 1.001, DPT 5.001...5.004) per functional description ch. 4.2.4.11 (Presence Simulation, FP 701 CT IP)
INFO.DESCRIPTION_DE: Aufzeichnung und sekundengenaue Wiedergabe von KNX/EIB-Telegrammen (DPT 1.001, DPT 5.001...5.004) gemäß Funktionsbeschreibung Kap. 4.2.4.11 (Anwesenheitssimulation, FP 701 CT IP)
INFO.DESCRIPTION_EN: Recording and time-accurate playback of KNX/EIB telegrams (DPT 1.001, DPT 5.001...5.004) per functional description ch. 4.2.4.11 (Presence Simulation, FP 701 CT IP)

PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Datapoints for controlling and monitoring the telegram recording (duration, start/stop, status)
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_DE: Datenpunkte zur Steuerung und Überwachung der Telegrammaufzeichnung (Dauer, Start/Stop, Status)
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_EN: Datapoints for controlling and monitoring the telegram recording (duration, start/stop, status)

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Maximum recording duration in days (24h periods, 1...7)
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Maximum recording duration in days (24h periods, 1...7)

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: A completed telegram sequence is available (playback group visible)
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Eine abgeschlossene Telegrammfolge ist verfügbar (Wiedergabegruppe sichtbar)
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: A completed telegram sequence is available (playback group visible)

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Number of recorded telegrams (status line), max. 2100
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Number of recorded telegrams (status line), max. 2100

PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Datapoints for controlling and monitoring the telegram playback (type, start delay, start/stop, status)
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_DE: Datenpunkte zur Steuerung und Überwachung der Telegrammwiedergabe (Art, Startverzögerung, Start/Stop, Status)
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_EN: Datapoints for controlling and monitoring the telegram playback (type, start delay, start/stop, status)

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Repeating: time of day only / Weekday: time of day + weekday
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Wiederholend: nur Uhrzeit / Wochentag: Uhrzeit + Wochentag
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: Repeating: time of day only / Weekday: time of day + weekday

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Delay before playback actually starts after pressing 'Start'
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_DE: Verzögerung, bevor die Wiedergabe nach Drücken von 'Start' tatsächlich beginnt
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Delay before playback actually starts after pressing 'Start'

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Communication object 'Start/stop playback'; also the 'Start'/'Stop' button for playback
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Kommunikationsobjekt 'Wiedergabe starten/stoppen'; entspricht auch dem Taster 'Start'/'Stop' der Wiedergabe
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: Communication object 'Start/stop playback'; also the 'Start'/'Stop' button for playback

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Remaining playback start delay in seconds (status line)
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_DE: Verbleibende Startverzögerung der Wiedergabe in Sekunden (Statuszeile)
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Remaining playback start delay in seconds (status line)

PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Datapoints shared across recording and playback (selection count, current weekday)
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_DE: Ordnerübergreifende Datenpunkte für Aufzeichnung und Wiedergabe (Auswahlzähler, aktueller Wochentag)
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_EN: Datapoints shared across recording and playback (selection count, current weekday)

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Number of functions currently selected for the simulation (max. 32)
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_DE: Anzahl der aktuell für die Simulation ausgewählten Funktionen (max. 32)
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Number of functions currently selected for the simulation (max. 32)

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Current weekday 1=Monday...7=Sunday; can be set directly on the panel or via WEEKDAY_SYNC
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_DE: Aktueller Wochentag 1=Montag...7=Sonntag; kann direkt am Panel oder über WEEKDAY_SYNC gesetzt werden
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Current weekday 1=Monday...7=Sunday; can be set directly on the panel or via WEEKDAY_SYNC

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Weekday field of a DPT 10.001 time telegram (0=no weekday); updates CURRENT_WEEKDAY
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_DE: Wochentagsfeld eines DPT-10.001-Zeittelegramms (0=kein Wochentag); aktualisiert CURRENT_WEEKDAY
PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION_EN: Weekday field of a DPT 10.001 time telegram (0=no weekday); updates CURRENT_WEEKDAY

PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Parent folder containing all created functions (recording objects), binary and analog
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_DE: Übergeordneter Ordner, der alle angelegten Funktionen (Recording-Objekte) enthält, binär und analog
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_EN: Parent folder containing all created functions (recording objects), binary and analog

PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Binary functions (DPT 1.001) - create one instance per binary recording object
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_DE: Binäre Funktionen (DPT 1.001) - pro binärem Recording-Objekt eine Instanz anlegen
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_EN: Binary functions (DPT 1.001) - create one instance per binary recording object

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Include this function in the presence simulation (max. 32 functions in total, binary+analog)
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Diese Funktion in die Anwesenheitssimulation einbeziehen (max. 32 Funktionen insgesamt, binär+analog)
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: Include this function in the presence simulation (max. 32 functions in total, binary+analog)

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Incoming binary telegram (DPT 1.001); link to the KNX group address to be RECORDED (recording input). While a recording is active and this function is selected, every change here is stored with a time/weekday stamp.
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Eingehendes binäres Telegramm (DPT 1.001); mit der aufzuzeichnenden KNX-Gruppenadresse verknüpfen (Aufzeichnungseingang). Bei aktiver Aufzeichnung und ausgewählter Funktion wird jede Änderung hier mit Zeit-/Wochentagsstempel gespeichert.
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: Incoming binary telegram (DPT 1.001); link to the KNX group address to be RECORDED (recording input). While a recording is active and this function is selected, every change here is stored with a time/weekday stamp.

PVTIME.DESCRIPTION: Time of the last telegram recorded on the input of this function
PVTIME.DESCRIPTION_DE: Zeitpunkt des letzten am Eingang dieser Funktion aufgezeichneten Telegramms
PVTIME.DESCRIPTION_EN: Time of the last telegram recorded on the input of this function

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Outgoing binary telegram (DPT 1.001); link to the KNX group address to be CONTROLLED during playback (playback output). The script writes the recorded values here during playback.
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Ausgehendes binäres Telegramm (DPT 1.001); mit der während der Wiedergabe zu steuernden KNX-Gruppenadresse verknüpfen (Wiedergabeausgang). Das Skript schreibt die aufgezeichneten Werte während der Wiedergabe hierher.
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: Outgoing binary telegram (DPT 1.001); link to the KNX group address to be CONTROLLED during playback (playback output). The script writes the recorded values here during playback.

PVTIME.DESCRIPTION: Time of the last telegram sent on the output of this function during playback
PVTIME.DESCRIPTION_DE: Zeitpunkt des letzten während der Wiedergabe am Ausgang dieser Funktion gesendeten Telegramms
PVTIME.DESCRIPTION_EN: Time of the last telegram sent on the output of this function during playback

PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Analog functions (DPT 5.001...5.004) - create one instance per analog recording object
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_DE: Analoge Funktionen (DPT 5.001...5.004) - pro analogem Recording-Objekt eine Instanz anlegen
PVFOLDER.DESCRIPTION_EN: Analog functions (DPT 5.001...5.004) - create one instance per analog recording object

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Include this function in the presence simulation (max. 32 functions in total, binary+analog)
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_DE: Diese Funktion in die Anwesenheitssimulation einbeziehen (max. 32 Funktionen insgesamt, binär+analog)
PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION_EN: Include this function in the presence simulation (max. 32 functions in total, binary+analog)
